summary: Dependency resolved from off-registry HTTPS URL enables arbitrary install-time code execution
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `marker-index-symbol-schema` as a bare HTTPS URL (`https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/marker-index-symbol-schema`) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL returns, unpinned and without integrity verification, and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in that tarball. The shipped `index.js` is a thin stub that re-exports the fetched module, so the manifest line is effectively the whole published surface. Whoever controls `artifacts.creditslib.com` controls code that executes on every installer's machine at install and require time. The package metadata (generic `author: Package Registry`, placeholder repository) combined with the off-registry single-dependency stub matches a dependency-confusion payload-delivery shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
